sinopsis.es: En una gran ciudad, varios personajes faltos de afecto buscan una relación y se ven envueltos en situaciones tan cómicas como absurdas, divertidas y emotivas.
sinopsis.en: A dark comedy about humankind’s desire to love and to be loved. Centred around neediness, intimacy and romance.  Told through a series of loosely connected, tender and absurd scenes, the film follows people who are searching for closeness and acceptance. In a world that preaches self-control, the film explores the sides we try to hide, such as feeling needy and pathetic.  The stories overlap and reappear, gradually forming a portrait of collective longing.
